notes.title: DISRUPTION Dev Update
notes.notes:
DISRUPTION Dev Update

Hacker Loadout Example

Here is a brief intro to the Hacker Loadout.

The BattlePad Computer allows for system takeover, breach and overload.
Systems that can be compromised include:
[list]
[*] Electrical Grid
[*] Utility Lines
[*] Communication Connection
[*] AI Nodes
[/list]

In addition the EW-X 'Electro Whip' discharges high voltage to overload an assailant.

The Hacker loadout is a powerful toolset to achieve objectives and cause severe environmental damage.

[previewyoutube=ufvjYtOY5Ps;full][/previewyoutube]

DISRUPTION Dev Update

Maker Loadout Example!

Here is a brief intro to the Maker Loadout.

Tools include the Maker Hand, an AI driven construction manipulator that can rapidly build:
[list]
[*] Blast Shields
[*] Barricades
[*] Turrets
[*] Traps
[*] and More!!
[/list]

This device allows for a tower defense aspect to the game play.

notes.title: DISRUPTION Dev Update
notes.notes:
DISRUPTION Dev Update

Development on DISRUPTION continues at a fevered pace. A vertical slice for demo purposes is almost complete and core game development resumes.

BOSS ALERT!
Our first boss fight is shaping up nicely. An over-sized Regex has been spotted roaming the ends of Robot Row. Beware his metal claws and methane breath.
